M01-L01.title: Frame a useful decision
M01-L01.description: Choose the decision and cost of being wrong before choosing the model.

M01-L02.title: Specify quality and economics
M01-L02.description: Count the full cost per successful outcome, including human review and failures.

M01-L03.title: Design human control
M01-L03.description: Match the assistant’s action to the evidence and make recovery easy.

M01-L04.title: Choose a delivery boundary
M01-L04.description: Release the smallest useful capability whose failures you can observe and contain.

M02-L01.title: Build reproducible Python components
M02-L01.description: Make inputs, dependencies and failures visible instead of relying on notebook memory.

M02-L05.title: Operate on arrays without shape surprises
M02-L05.description: Match each rental’s days to its own daily rate, then verify the output shape and a hand-calculated cost before trusting the total.

M02-L02.title: Design service contracts
M02-L02.description: Receiving a response and receiving valid business data are different successes.

M02-L03.title: Control concurrent work
M02-L03.description: Bound admission and active calls separately, then await cleanup when work is cancelled.

M02-L04.title: Persist and test behavior
M02-L04.description: Commit related rows together, recognize repeated request keys, and test what remains after failure.

M03-L01.title: When similarity changes its mind
M03-L01.description: Move vectors and discover why dot product and cosine can disagree.

M03-L02.title: Understand optimization
M03-L02.description: A downhill direction helps only when the step size is suitable.

M03-L03.title: Model uncertainty
M03-L03.description: An alert’s meaning depends on both detector behaviour and how common the underlying problem is.

M03-L04.title: Compare experiments honestly
M03-L04.description: A small observed win needs uncertainty and sampling context before it supports a release.

M04-L01.title: Establish supervised baselines
M04-L01.description: Judge a model against a simple baseline on the decision you actually need.

M04-L02.title: Protect the evaluation boundary
M04-L02.description: Protect the evaluation boundary before trusting a good score.

M04-L03.title: Handle imperfect predictions
M04-L03.description: Choose an action threshold by inspecting its mistakes and workload.

M04-L04.title: Discover structure and diagnose fit
M04-L04.description: A beautiful training result is useful only if it survives new cases.

M05-L01.title: Trace a learning step
M05-L01.description: Backward computes gradients; the optimizer uses them to change parameters.

M05-L02.title: Stabilize optimization
M05-L02.description: Change one factor at a time so a failed learning run has an explainable cause.

M05-L03.title: Control generalization
M05-L03.description: Use the right layer mode and gradient mode, then judge on untouched examples.

M05-L04.title: Choose representations and architectures
M05-L04.description: Choose an architecture for the structure of the evidence, then test its assumptions.

M06-L01.title: Define dataset contracts
M06-L01.description: Validate both the record and the time when the system could know it.

M06-L02.title: Curate reliable labels
M06-L02.description: Agreement is useful evidence about consistency, but it is not proof of truth.

M06-L03.title: Version and trace data
M06-L03.description: A model result needs a traceable data snapshot and transformation, not just a filename.

M06-L04.title: Operate the data lifecycle
M06-L04.description: Follow a data change through its derived copies and report unfinished work honestly.

M17-L01.title: An answer needs evidence
M17-L01.description: Trace policy evidence through retrieval, context, citations and abstention.

M21-L02.title: The refund that happened twice
M21-L02.description: Crash an agent and compare blind retries with stable intent and receipt reconciliation.

M02-L06.title: Transform dataframes with trustworthy joins
M02-L06.description: Join each rental to one equipment rate, audit row counts and missing matches, then group or reshape only the checked charges.

M02-L07.title: Inspect datasets and communicate uncertainty
M02-L07.description: Show the observed values, group sizes and missing counts beside an average; equal means do not imply similar customers or complete evidence.

M02-L08.title: Read and run a Python program
M02-L08.description: Track the value and type of each name, follow the chosen branch, and enter a function body only when it is called.
